# Tesseract language data

`vendor/tessdata/ara.traineddata` and `vendor/tessdata/eng.traineddata` are
Tesseract language models distributed by the `@tesseract.js-data` project.

- Source: https://github.com/naptha/tessdata
- Upstream data: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best
- License: Apache License 2.0

The Apache License text is included in `tesseract.js-LICENSE.md`.
